### findings
Each finding: verdict — symptom → root cause → evidence → demonstrated consequence → location; tasks it bears on.

**C1 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (XF8 overwrite hygiene, five members).** Symptom: overwrites retire a base clause for every case while their `replaced_by` restates nothing for the cases outside the policy's scope, or defer to the very clause they retire. Evidence and consequence per member:
- C1-a P2 overwrite of ortho_evt_case_transfer s1 ("…the unpaid part of the case benefit … is re-spread over the installments still due, paid to the new practice when it is in network and to the member otherwise"). replaced_by: "…only that first carried payment is fixed this way, and every other installment of a case remains under the installment rules of the rider." The installment rule for a moved case's second and later installments *was* the retired sentence; after the overwrite no in-force sentence fixes the amount or the payee of any installment after the first carried one.
- C1-b P2 overwrite of ortho_evt_benefit_calculation s4 (equal installments, count = months/period rounded up, each = remainder/count, last absorbs). replaced_by covers only "the first carried payment". The sentence is retired for every new-start case too; the in-force charter no longer says how an ordinary installment schedule is computed (the seeded 56.30 / 140.63 installments of both worlds have no in-force rule behind them).
- C1-c P3 overwrite of ortho_evt_case_eligibility s2 (waiting periods by market/age/late entrant, last-day-of-month convention, month-for-month credit). replaced_by ends "…every case banded on or after the end of its waiting period remains under the base case rules" — defers to the retired clause and restates none of it; ordinary new starts lose their coverage-timing rule, and "its waiting period" is defined nowhere in force except inside P3's fee computation (which adds an extended tenure reduction).
- C1-d P3 overwrite of ortho_evt_case_eligibility s5 (genuine takeovers: ortho_takeover_allowed, minimum months on the rider effective date, waiting/age limit not applying, lifetime maximum applying). replaced_by: "The new-start entry is the latest establishment entry under the rider; a case whose months … are fewer than the rider's takeover minimum months is not re-established." Every genuine takeover (treatment begun under another carrier or before the rider) loses its coverage rule; the clash with P3 was only the anchor of the minimum-months test.
- C1-e P4 overwrite of ortho_evt_payment_reversal s1 (reversal grounds: after termination, duplicate, above the maximum; full or excess). replaced_by: "…only such returns are fixed this way, and every other reversal remains under the base reversal rules" — defers to the retired clause; ordinary reversal grounds are no longer in force (task 0's seeded duplicate reversal dbadfe73 rests on that clause).
Location: ortho.extended.yaml P2.overwrite[0..1], P3.overwrite[0..1], P4.overwrite[0]. Tasks: charter-global; no scored value of task 0 or 1 moves (their scored writes are inside the replacing scopes).

**C2 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (undeclared override, P2 vs ortho_evt_case_transfer s2).** Base s2 (in force; P2 overwrites only s1): "when the new practice's allowed fee for the remaining treatment is lower than the unpaid benefit divided by the rider coinsurance, the unpaid benefit is reduced to the coinsurance share of that lower fee." P2: "The carried benefit is the lesser of the unpaid case benefit and the rider coinsurance … applied to the recognised remaining-treatment fee on that entry" + "For the first carried payment to a new practice that holds no Cascade agreement, only part of the recognised remaining-treatment fee is allowed … the high allowance percent of it … the low allowance percent of it…". Root cause: the oon_allowance factor scales the very fee that s2 caps against, and the transfer row's allowed_case_fee is by schema already "the out-of-network allowance otherwise". Consequence: two clauses fix the same carried benefit with different numbers on any out-of-network transfer — demonstrated on task 0 (base s2 reading 115.92 vs P2 reading 98.53; see 0.md). Location: P2.rule (allowance sentence), P2.overwrite (s2 not named), compute `allowance_pct`/`result`.

**C3 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (undeclared override, P4/P3 vs ortho_evt_benefit_calculation s1-s2).** Base s2 (in force; not named by any overwrite): "For a takeover case the benefit so computed is prorated by months_remaining divided by treatment_months (rounded half up to the cent) and is paid in installments only"; s1: "…minus any unused ortho_lifetime_deductible…". P4: "The takeover benefit is the rider coinsurance for the network status on the latest establishment entry applied to the recognised fee on that entry, rounded half up to the cent, and limited to …" — no proration, no deductible. P3 writes the takeover entry's allowed_case_fee already as the covered-treatment fee (prorated by months still to come). Consequence: the base clause prorates the P3 fee a second time; on task 1 the base reading gives 187.50 vs P4's 166.47 (see 1.md). On Family riders (deductible 50) the deductible omission would move the takeover benefit by 25.00-30.00 (coinsurance share of 50). Location: P4.rule (takeover benefit sentence), P4.base_policy_refs (benefit_calculation absent), P3.overwrite (s2 of benefit_calculation not named).

**C4 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (undeclared departures with no task effect).** (a) ortho_agg_lifetime_maximum s1: "The orthodontic lifetime maximum is per person and counts every orthodontic payment Cascade has made for that person under any rider, including riders that have since terminated" vs P2/P4 "limited to the rider's lifetime maximum less the payments, net of reversals, made under the rider for other cases" (compute SUM is rider-scoped by the DSL). A person with an earlier terminated rider holding payments gets a higher cap under P2/P4 than under the base. (b) ortho_evt_benefit_calculation s1 "minus any unused ortho_lifetime_deductible" (per person, lifetime) vs P2 "less the rider's lifetime deductible when the case is the first case established under the rider" (+ compute `COUNT(established)==1`, which also fails for a first case carrying two establishment entries). (c) ortho_evt_payment_reversal s3 "recovers the amount from the payee (offset against future payments to a practice, or billed to the member)" vs P4 "recorded as a reversal of the case's initial payment recovered from the member … keeping that payment's … payee": on an in-network case the initial payment's payee is the practice, so the row says payee practice while the rule recovers from the member. (d) P4 repayment_measure tier 2 (lifetime-maximum excess) handles a reversal ground that P4's own overwrite routes back to "the base reversal rules", where the excess is reversed on the payment that crossed the maximum, not on the initial payment. Consequence: second answers exist in worlds with a prior rider, a Family-rider first case with two establishment entries, an in-network waiting-period case, or a lifetime-maximum excess; neither task world contains one (tasks 0/1: one rider, deductible 0, task 1 payee member, no excess). Location: P2.rule/compute case_benefit/first_case; P4.rule/compute takeover_benefit/measure_code; P4.overwrite.

**C5 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (XF1/XF2: factors gated through other factors; baseline defines factor-only quantities).** No binding reads another factor's binding, but the combination makes one factor's baseline erase another factor's effect:
- C5-a P2 interest_rate_by_payee × overdue_measure: interest = payment × rate × overdue months; either at baseline (0) zeroes the other; "interest" is a quantity the baseline never defines (baseline: "the first carried payment is one such share"). Demonstrated on task 0 (0.md): interest baseline with overdue on its tier → 97.55; both at baseline → 97.55.
- C5-b P3 waiting_months gates prior_coverage_credit and dental_tenure: net waiting = max(0, wait − credit − tenure); with waiting_months at its baseline 0 neither reduction can act; the baseline rule itself defines "The net waiting months are the waiting months less every reduction that applies" — reductions only factors supply. Demonstrated on task 1 (1.md): wait baseline + credit/tenure on their tiers → 2796.00; all three at baseline → 2796.00.
- C5-c P4 repayment_measure gates takeover_schedule_start, takeover_installment_count and pre_coverage_gap_share: those three shape "the takeover installments payable to date", which only measure tier 1 uses; the baseline defines that quantity ("By the standard method the takeover benefit is spread … a takeover installment is payable to date once…") but the baseline repayment ("repays the whole initial payment") never uses it. Demonstrated on task 1: measure at baseline with the three others on their tiers → 187.50; with all four at baseline → 187.50.
Location: P2.compute result/interest_rate/overdue_months; P3.compute result/baseline.rule; P4.compute result/measure_code/baseline.rule.

**C6 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (unreal ladders: tiers with equal outcomes, conditions that hold of everyone in scope).**
- C6-a P3 waiting_months: tiers 2 and 3 select P('ortho_wait_months_individual_child') and P('ortho_wait_months_group_late_entrant'), which are 12 and 12 in all six variants (ortho.yaml lines 88/90, 141/143, 194/196, 247/249, 300/302, 353/355); on the three Child riders tier 1 selects ortho_wait_months_individual_adult = 0, the fall-through's value. The fall-through ("none for any other enrollment", 0) is outside P3's scope: P3 applies only to a case "placed … before the rider's waiting period for the case ended", impossible with no waiting period.
- C6-b P2 interest_rate_by_payee: fall-through "no transfer entry" can never hold for a customer reaching this write (P2 fixes the payment "after it has moved to the new orthodontist", and its prerequisite requires a transfer entry); the ladder has two reachable tiers.
- C6-c P4 repayment_measure: tier 1 "the latest establishment entry is a takeover entry AND the case carries an initial payment" holds of every customer reaching the write (scope: a case re-established as a takeover; prerequisite: latest establishment entry is a takeover; the superseded new-start entry triggered ortho_initial_payment, and COUNT counts that row even if reversed). Tiers 2-3 are never selected in scope.
- C6-d P4 takeover_schedule_start: tier-1 conjunct "a case banded on or after the rider effective date" holds of every in-scope case (scope: "appliances were placed after the rider effective date"); tier 2 (coverage-ended closure restored by reinstatement) is the base reinstatement takeover, which P4's scope ("re-established as a takeover because its appliances were placed before its waiting period ended") excludes; tier 3 (banded before the effective date / no takeover) is outside scope. One reachable tier.
Location: the four `factors[].ladder` entries and the matching rule sentences.

**C7 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (mislabelled method; P3 has no method factor).** prior_coverage_credit is labelled `method`, but tier 1 ("waived entirely, the reduction being the full-waiver months" = constant 99) and tier 3 ("nothing" = constant 0) are the same empty combination with different constants — a parameter difference (method-shape test FAIL on T1–T3). P3's other five factors are `parameter`; P3 therefore has 0 surviving method factors (floor 1). Location: P3.factors[1], P3.rule credit sentence.

**C8 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (realism: tiers or values no US dental/vision carrier publishes).**
- C8-a P2 interest_rate_by_payee + overdue_measure: "late-payment interest" on the first carried payment counted from the issue date of the last installment paid to the previous practice. Prompt-pay interest (e.g. Washington's 1%-per-month rule for clean claims unpaid after 60 days) runs from receipt of a clean claim; here Cascade could not pay the new practice before the transfer existed (P2's own prerequisite), so no claim was late. The rate split by payee (member 1.0 %, practice 1.5 %) is not a published schedule; the quarterly tier counts quarters ("divided by three") and multiplies them by a rate stated "per overdue month"; and the interest is booked inside the installment, so it counts against the lifetime maximum, which statutory interest never does.
- C8-b P3 covered_fee_allowance: the new-start entry's allowed_case_fee is already the out-of-network allowance (schema: "the contracted fee for a participating practice, the out-of-network allowance otherwise"; parameter ortho_oon_allowance_basis "used as allowed_case_fee for a non-participating practice"); taking 88 %/78 % of it again on the same UCR basis applies the UCR limit twice. (P2 oon_allowance has the same shape; its consequence is filed under C2.)
- C8-c P4 pre_coverage_gap_share: cuts the takeover benefit by 10-20 % for 3+ / 6+ months of treatment before coverage, although P3's fee already removed those months (proration) and the start-of-treatment share; and the cut applies only "for the member's repayment", i.e. to a phantom schedule no payment follows.
- C8-d P4 aged_recovery: recovering 50 % of a member overpayment issued 6-11 whole months ago is not industry practice (recovery is full inside the lookback and nil outside it; the base already sets the 365-day lookback).
- C8-e P2 payment_spread on quarterly riders: tier 1 takes "the lesser of those months remaining and the installments left on the original schedule, divided by three" and tier 2 compares "months remaining" with "the installments left" — months against quarterly installment counts. Example on a quarterly rider (Child 1000/1500, Family 1500): 14 months remaining, 4 quarterly installments left → tier 1 gives ceil(min(14,4)/3) = 2 payments for 14 months of treatment.
- C8-f P3 baseline "By the standard measure the waiting months of the case are zero": inside P3's scope every case has a waiting period (the base standard gives 12 or 24 months); a reader of the computation document alone treats a case banded inside the waiting period as having none — a zero where the standard method gives a figure.
Location: P2.factors[3..4], P2.factors[2]; P3.factors[5], P3.baseline; P4.factors[3..4].

**C9 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (XF2: assembly sentences name factor quantities).** P1: "…multiplied by the share of treatment still to come and by the carry percentage, every records amount is then subtracted…"; P2: "every allowance percentage … every reserve percentage … interest worked out on that rounded payment at the interest rate for the overdue months…"; P3: "…by the allowance percentage, every records amount…"; P4: "every share percentage … the recovery percentage is applied…". Consequence: the computation document, which must be silent about factors, names the carry, interest, allowance and recovery quantities. Location: the `result` compute_basis sentence of each policy. Tasks: both (no scored value moves).

**C10 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (XF5/XF6 edges without a rule sentence; month-end conventions).** Members: P1 quarterly tier divides by (planned − 1) = 0 for a one-month plan; P1 "a case with no establishment entry has no recognised remaining-treatment fee" while the compute raises on None; P1/P3/P4 establishment-entry same-day ties unstated; P2 first_case decoy (two establishment entries on one case); P2 overdue "whole calendar months" without a month-end convention; P3 months still to come floored only in compute; P3 `planned_months == 0` branch without a sentence; P3 absent attached enrollment → MONTHS(None) raises; P3 whole-month conventions (effective→banding, tenure, 19th birthday on a 29 February DOB) unstated; P4 payable installments uncapped by the schedule length; P4 schedule-start tier 2 with no installment payment raises; P4 "six / twelve whole calendar months" without convention. None is reached in task 0 or 1 (dates there have no month-end or tie edge). Location: the cited compute lines.

**C11 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (factor floors after strikes).** P2: interest_rate_by_payee and overdue_measure struck (C6-b, C8-a) → ≤3 factors (oon_allowance, retention_reserve, payment_spread). P3: prior_coverage_credit struck as method (C7) → 0 method; waiting_months and covered_fee_allowance struck (C6-a, C8-b). P4: repayment_measure, takeover_schedule_start (C6-c/d), pre_coverage_gap_share, aged_recovery (C8-c/d) struck → 1 factor, 0 parameter. Tasks: task 0 (P2), task 1 (P3, P4).

Observations (not grounds for rework):
- O1 The DSL's `RND` is Python `round` (half-even on exact binary halves), while every rule says half up; the seeded installment 140.63 (task 1) follows the rule (Python gives 140.62). No scored computation of either task lands on an exact half.
- O2 Docstring wording: "Afterwards…" (takeover tool) describes its own effect; "on a case that has moved…" (issue tool) scopes the tool. Neither sequences tools.
- O3 move_ortho_case is owner=user, but P1 says "Cascade fixes on the transfer entry of the case the fee it recognises", and blueprint.yaml line 33 lists the subscriber's own acts (appeal, withdrawal, free-look, termination, plan change) without case transfers. A subscriber entering Cascade's recognised fee is not real practice. The engine lets only the user call the tool, so no second scored path; ownership is discoverable only from the tool contract/KB.
- O4 P2 and P4 opening sentences restate their dependency as action-form scope clauses (see prerequisite_sentences).
- O5 P1 carry_percent rationale ("each new orthodontist repeats part of the start-up work … so the fee is multiplied by" 90/80 %) is weakly motivated (the first move repeats start-up work too) but limiting benefits on repeated transfers is seen in practice.
- O6 D0150 (comprehensive oral evaluation) is not an orthodontic records code; it is deducted only alongside a pano. In both worlds the lines are the orthodontist's own new-patient visit billed to dental, which makes the ladder plausible there.
- O7 P1 redefines the transfer row's allowed_case_fee (base: the new practice's recognised fee / OON allowance) without declaring it; the base reading has no computable figure (no UCR table), so no second number can be shown.
- O8 P3 re-establishes cases on Child 1000 (ortho_takeover_allowed false, minimum 0) as takeovers; and a case below the takeover minimum is "not re-established" with no stated outcome.

**R2-C1 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (XF8, new members).** (a) P2 overwrite of transfer s1: replaced_by ends "…the rule applies to a person whose current rider is the only Cascade orthodontic rider the person has held" — for a person with an earlier rider the retired re-spread/payee clause is restated by nothing. (b) P4 overwrite of reversal s1: "this applies to a person whose current rider is the only …" attaches either to the takeover addition or to the whole sentence; on the wide reading the restated base grounds (after termination, duplicate, above maximum) lapse for multi-rider persons. (c) P4 overwrite of benefit_calculation s2 ("For a takeover case the benefit so computed is prorated … and is paid in installments only, with no initial payment"): replaced_by opens "For the member's repayment, …" — actual takeover installments (re-established cases going forward, from-start takeovers, reinstatement takeovers) keep no in-force proration / installments-only rule. No task score moves.

**R2-C2 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (straw baselines contradicted by in-force base s1).** Base ortho_evt_benefit_calculation s1 (in force): "The case benefit is the allowed_case_fee minus any unused ortho_lifetime_deductible, times the rider coinsurance for the case network (ortho_coinsurance_in_network or ortho_coinsurance_oon)…". P2 standard: "the rider's in-network coinsurance applied to the allowed case fee"; P2/P4 deductible baselines 0. The tiers of case_benefit_basis (T2/T3) and of unused_deductible / takeover_deductible (T1) are base s1 itself, so a reader of base s1 alone computes the tiered values; the baselines are "the correct value under another name" inverted — a figure the in-force charter contradicts. Demonstrated on task 0 (case benefit from base s1 = 40 % × (3600 − 50) = 1420.00 = the tiered value) and task 1 (deductible 50 from base s1 = the tiered value). Location: P2.rule standard-measure sentence, P2.factors[0..1].baseline, P4.factors[1].baseline.

**R2-C3 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (residual double proration, P2 vs P4).** P2 case_benefit_basis T1: "for a takeover entry it is the rider coinsurance … applied to the allowed case fee and then prorated by the months remaining over the planned treatment months"; P4: "for a takeover entry that supersedes a new-start entry of the same case, the fee on it already covers only the treatment from the start of coverage, so the coinsurance applies to that fee without proration". A P3-re-established case that later moves gets its covered-treatment fee prorated a second time by P2. No task world contains such a case.

**R2-C6 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (unreal ladders, new members).** (a) P3 waiting_months T2 ("a group enrollment AND it did not enter as a late entrant" → 0): with no waiting months coverage begins in the rider's first month, so no such case is "placed before coverage of the case began"; two reachable tiers. (b) P4 takeover_benefit_basis T1 holds of every customer reaching the write (a repayment is non-zero only for a case that had a new-start initial payment, i.e. a P3-superseded case). (c) P3 covered_fee_basis T2 and P2 case_benefit_basis T2 apply min(allowed, treatment fee); the allowed case fee is "the contracted fee for a participating practice, the out-of-network allowance otherwise" and P3 itself says "Cascade never recognises more than the practice charges", so on every state the charter can produce min() returns the allowed fee and T2 coincides with T3 (P3) or differs from T3 only by the coinsurance constant (P2). Task 1 makes P3's T2 bear weight only through a seed with allowed 5600.00 > fee 5400.00 (T1-R2-3). (d) P2 unused_deductible / P4 takeover_deductible: tier 1 equals the fall-through (0) on the four riders with a 0.00 deductible, and tier 2 requires earlier orthodontic cases whose allowed fees total less than $50.

**R2-C8 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (realism).** P3 covered_month_count T1 rounds the covered months down to whole quarters ("counted to match the installment schedule"), dropping the partial first quarter from the fee, while P4 schedules an installment for that same quarter (installment count ceil(20/3) = 7) and pays two thirds of it (first_period_share). The partial quarter is removed twice; no carrier sizes a covered fee by whole payment quarters. Demonstrated on task 1 (1.md).

**R2-C10 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (residual XF6).** P3's "whole calendar months" counts (rider effective date → banding date, dental tenure, 19th birthday via MONTHS ≥ 228) use an end-day rule no P3 sentence states. No task date hits the edge.

**R2-C11 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (floors after strikes).** P2: 3 surviving factors, 1 parameter; P3: 0 surviving method factors; P4: 3 surviving factors.

**R3-C3 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (cross-policy coinsurance for a superseding takeover).** P4 restated s1: "the coinsurance of such a takeover entry follows the network terms stated in this rule" (new-start network kept when the case has no transfer entry); P2 standard: "times the rider coinsurance for the network status on that entry". A P3-re-established case whose practice joined the network, later moved, gets 40 % under P4's terms and 50 % under P2 (Family 1500). No task world contains it.

**R3-C6 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (tariff coincidence).** practice_network_ratio's three tiers all select 1 on the riders whose in- and out-of-network coinsurance are equal (Child 1500, Child 2000, Family 2000). Not struck; no effect on task 0 (Family 1500, 50/40).

**R3-C7 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (XF7 decoy reads, provider-agnostic records).** P1 dental_records, P3 banding_visit_records and P4 progress_records_offset read paid D0150/D0330 lines of the patient's enrollment from any practice. Probe: a general dentist's routine D0150 or D0330 inside P1's 6-month window, on the banding date, or after the coverage month would be deducted as orthodontic records (P4: a later general-dentist pano displaces the orthodontist's progress pano as "the latest"). Orthodontic records are part of the orthodontist's case fee only when the orthodontist takes them; a general dentist's exam or pano is a separate covered dental service. This class existed since revision_1 (recorded then only as observation O6 on the D0150 code); it is reported now as a read defect. No task world carries such a decoy (the deducted lines are the treating orthodontist's).

**R3-C8 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (realism).** (a) appliance_removal_part: the removal of appliances at completion is part of the comprehensive case fee (CDT D8695 covers removal only "for reasons other than completion of treatment"); no carrier values a 4 % / 2 % debond share separately from the retention phase, and the factor duplicates the kept-whole mechanism of retention_part. (b) covered_fee_basis tier 2: "for a case whose planned treatment months after the banding month exceed the rider's installment months cap, it is the allowed case fee multiplied by the cap and divided by those months, because no installment is ever paid beyond the cap" — the cap limits how the remainder is spread, not how much is paid: base ortho_evt_benefit_calculation s4 (in force) pays "the rest of the case benefit … in equal installments … over the planned treatment months after the banding month limited to ortho_installment_months_cap", i.e. the whole remainder within the cap, and P4's own count spreads the takeover benefit over installments inside the cap. Demonstrated on task 1 (1.md).

**R3-C11 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (floor).** P3 keeps no surviving method factor after R3-C8b.
